===================== officier =====================
id="content">
Officiers
Back
Geologist
(Level 10/30)
The Geologist is a expert in astro-mineralogy and crystalography. He assists his teams in metallurgy and chemistry as he also takes care of the interplanetary communications optimising the use and refining of the raw material along the empire.
Recruit:  Dark Matter:
4.046
Admiral
(Level 5/20)
The Admiral is an experienced veteran and a skillful strategist. The hardest battle is able to get an idea of the situation and contact their admirals subordinates. A wise emperor could rely on their help during the fighting.
Recruit:  Dark Matter:
2.488
Engineer
(Level 5/10)
The Engineer is a specialist in energy management. In peacetime, it increases the energy of all the colonies.
Recruit:  Dark Matter:
11.391
Technocrat
(Level 1/10)
The guild of the Technocrats is composed of genius scientists, and you will find them always over the realm where all human logic would be defied. For thousands of years, no normal humans have ever cracked the code of a Technocrat. The Technocrat inspires the researchers of the empire with his presence.
Recruit:  Dark Matter:
2.250
Constructor
(Level 0/3)
The Constructor has altered their DNA, only one of these men can build an entire city in a short time.
Recruit:  Dark Matter:
3.000
Scientologist
(Level 3/3)
Scientists are part of a guild to concurrent technocrats. They specialize in the improvement of technologies.
Maximum level reached
Minister of Defence
(Level 0/2)
The Minister of Defence is a member of the Imperial Army. focus on your job allows you to build a formidable defense in a short period of time.
Recruit:  Dark Matter:
5.000
